purpose: What happens AFTER Kane (or the operator) has proposed hypotheses and corrections from the 100-game screen. Each phase needs its own operator-approved game budget; none of it runs in the screening phase.
rules: The 100 screening games (seeds 62001-62010) are exploratory and are never reused as validation or holdout evidence.
Hypotheses and their predictions are registered (hashed, journalled) before any validation game is played.
Single factors first: a combined intervention is only allowed after each factor has its own registered result.
Correction comparison uses seeds that hypothesis validation never touched.
The sealed holdout is used exactly once, after hypotheses AND corrections are frozen; its seed list is committed by hash below and revealed only at unsealing.
No correction is promoted to production by any phase of this protocol; promotion is a separate operator decision.
Every phase uses the offline batch runner: 0 external model calls during play is a hard requirement.

phases.goal: Hypothesis validation: does the pattern that motivated a hypothesis reproduce on fresh seeds, and do its predictions hold under its intervention?
phases.arms: control (the condition that showed the pattern) + one arm per registered single-factor intervention
phases.estimatedGames: 60 x (1 + interventions), e.g. 180 for two interventions

phases.goal: Correction comparison: bounded alternatives (e.g. P1 at 0.5 and 0.75, S3 at 2, S4 at 1) against control, judged by the acceptance gates in server/balance/v3/proposals.ts.
phases.estimatedGames: 80 x (1 + corrections), plus head-to-head games for planner changes

phases.goal: Final sealed holdout for the one or two frozen corrections that passed V3-CORRECT.
phases.seedCommitment: sha256 of the comma-separated seed list, recorded in balance/v3/journal.ndjson at entry 'protocol-sealed'

acceptanceGates: server/balance/v3/proposals.ts acceptCorrection(): behaviour changed, target moved by the pre-registered size with a 95% interval excluding 0, mean length at most +25% and turn-limit rate at most +10 points, first-mover edge not worse by more than 5 points, effect entropy not down by more than 0.1, comebacks not down by more than 10 points and lead changes not down by more than 25%, zero safety violations, independent seeds.
